end.summary:
Practised reading and writing 4-digit numbers in words and numerals.
Correctly identified 2,345 from “two thousand three hundred forty-five” once.
Discussed the thousands place using 7,382 and identified 7,000 as the value.
Mixed up spoken number parts with digit-by-digit writing; this was still seen at the end.
Teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised 4-digit numbers with Diya, including breaking numbers into thousands, hundreds, tens, and ones. Diya correctly connected the 7 in 7,382 with the thousands place and a value of 7,000. They still mixed up saying each part with writing the correct place-value digits, so this was not fully corrected by the end. At home, practise a few numbers by making a place-value chart and writing each digit in its column before saying the number aloud.
